title: 用exec入口转发容器停止信号并保持参数边界
body:
## 操作任务
实现write_entrypoint(path)：原子写入带set -eu与exec "$@"的POSIX入口脚本，确保可执行；拒绝符号链接和非普通文件。用真实父子进程复现sh为PID1时SIGTERM未传给业务子进程，再证明exec形式让业务进程直接收到SIGTERM，且参数含空格时不拆分。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
真实Linux shell与子进程观察SIGTERM；验证exec入口的PID信号、退出码、含空格参数和符号链接拒绝。

## 能力边界
临时Linux进程与文件系统内实测PID1样式shell子进程未收到SIGTERM；exec入口由同一PID直接承载业务进程，信号终止码为SIGTERM且参数保真。不构建镜像。
answer:
```python
import os,pathlib,tempfile

def write_entrypoint(path):
    path=pathlib.Path(path)
    if path.exists() and (path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file()):
        raise ValueError("target must be a regular file")
    data=b'#!/bin/sh\nset -eu\nexec "$@"\n'
    fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="."+path.name+".",dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as stream:
            stream.write(data);stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.chmod(tmp,0o755);os.replace(tmp,path);tmp=None
    finally:
        if tmp is not None and os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
    return path
```

原题知识说明：
在隔离环境发送标准停止信号，观察父子进程是否收到及业务排空日志。若包装器未转发信号，使用正确 exec/信号处理机制并验证退出码和在途请求；不要仅增大宽限期。灰度验证停止耗时和错误率后推广，异常则回退旧入口/镜像。

import importlib.util,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,os,signal,time
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',pathlib.Path('task.py'));task=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(task)
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: generate exec-form entrypoint',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='pid1 exec entry ') as d:
 root=pathlib.Path(d);parent=subprocess.Popen(['/bin/sh','-c','sleep 30 & echo $!; wait'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
 child=int(parent.stdout.readline().strip())
 try:
  parent.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM);parent.wait(timeout=3)
  try:os.kill(child,0)
  except ProcessLookupError:raise AssertionError('shell unexpectedly forwarded SIGTERM')
  print('NATIVE_OPERATION_ENTERED: shell PID 1 left child alive after SIGTERM',flush=True)
 finally:
  if parent.poll() is None:parent.kill();parent.wait(timeout=3)
  try:os.kill(child,signal.SIGKILL)
  except ProcessLookupError:pass
 entry=task.write_entrypoint(root/'entrypoint.sh');assert entry.stat().st_mode & 0o111
 assert entry.read_bytes()==b'#!/bin/sh\nset -eu\nexec "$@"\n'
 proc=subprocess.Popen([str(entry),'/usr/bin/python3','-c','import sys;print(sys.argv[1])','hello world'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 out,err=proc.communicate(timeout=5);assert proc.returncode==0 and out=='hello world\n',(proc.returncode,out,err)
 proc=subprocess.Popen([str(entry),'/bin/sleep','30']);time.sleep(.2);proc.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM);assert proc.wait(timeout=3)==-signal.SIGTERM
 link=root/'link';link.symlink_to(root/'entrypoint.sh')
 try:task.write_entrypoint(link)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('symlink target accepted')

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
